subject: MAP & compliance add-ons — pricing and timeline questions
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@medsys.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & compliance add-on questions

Karthik —

Thanks for the call earlier. We reviewed the MAP draft internally and have a few open items before we can sign off and push to a pilot:

- Can you confirm the expected timeline for evaluation -> pilot -> production ramp (we're trying to land in calendar Q2)?
- Pricing: we need clarity on how discounts are tied to committed spend vs. seat count. Also: how are compliance add-ons (audit logs, extended retention, premium access controls) priced? Are they one-time or recurring?
- Retention: our compliance team is asking for 13 months raw audit log retention (HIPAA-adjacent requirement). Is 13 months supported and what's the pricing delta vs. 12 months?

Please send an updated MAP with milestones and a pricing appendix for the compliance items. If we can align on milestones and pricing we want to try to close by end of Feb and start the pilot in early March.

Best,
Claire
Director, IT Compliance
MedSys Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & compliance add-on questions

Claire — thanks for the clear ask. I attached a refreshed MAP draft and a compliance pricing worksheet to this thread (see attachments). High-level answers below and then the doc has the milestone-level commitments we propose:

- Timeline (proposed):
  * Evaluation (sandbox + POC): 2 weeks (deep-dive + 1 test workflow)
  * Pilot: 4 weeks (50k tokens/day baseline, operational validation)
  * Production ramp: staged over 8 weeks post-pilot to your target throughput

- Discounts & commits:
  * We offer tiered discounts tied to committed monthly spend over 12 months. Example tiers in the worksheet: $25k/mo (3% discount), $50k/mo (7% discount + minor SLA bump), $100k/mo (12% discount + priority capacity).
  * Ramp language in MAP: a 3-month ramp where effective committed spend scales to target. Early months credit toward the annual commit.

- Compliance add-ons: audit logs, extended retention, and premium controls are licensed as recurring add-ons (monthly).
  * Audit logs: base retention 90 days included; 12 months add-on is priced at X per GB/month (see sheet). 13 months is available as a premium tier — price shown as a percentage uplift over 12 months.
  * Premium controls (fine-grained RBAC, advanced audit stream): separate SKU with a monthly fee or can be included at higher commit tiers.

I attached: audit-logs-pricing-sheet.xlsx and redwood-map-draft.pdf. If you like the MAP milestones we can convert to a DocuSign and aim for your Feb 28 target.

Thanks — cc'd Marissa and Steph to help with pricing flexibility and legal language.

—Karthik
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: internal: MAP discount flex and compliance bundling

Internal note —

Saw Claire's ask on 13 months. A few things to consider:

1) Discount levers: If they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity we can flex to 14% at $100k+/mo and include the premium controls SKU at no additional monthly fee for the first 6 months.
2) Audit logs retention: 13 months is uncommon but permissible — recommend we structure it as a paid add-on at 15% uplift on the 12-month price, billed monthly per GB. This avoids a one-off capital charge that procurement often pushes back on.
3) Close timing: If legal wants 2 weeks to review, Feb 28 is tight. Offer a DocuSign with the MAP + SOW and a contingency that the audit logs are provisioned after signature but price locked for 30 days.

I'll prepare a clean pricing appendix and a canary DocuSign template.

-M
From: Claire Barnes <claire@medsys.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@medsys.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 10:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & compliance add-on questions

Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple follow-ups from compliance/legal:

- SSO/SCIM: we need SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning. Is that included or an add-on?
- 13 months retention: procurement will push for one consolidated fee if possible (procurement hates per-GB line items). Can you provide an optional consolidated pricing line (annual fixed fee) in addition to the per-GB model?
- Can you confirm whether audit logs are considered part of data subject access requests (we need to keep an auditable chain)?

If you can provide consolidated pricing and SSO/SCIM commitment we will try to get legal to turn their redlines around quickly. Target remains Feb 28 if pricing is stable.

Best,
Claire
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@medsys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & compliance add-on questions

Claire — quick answers inline and attached the SOC2 attestation for your auditors.

- SSO/SCIM: SAML SSO included on enterprise plans; SCIM provisioning is available as an add-on but we can include it at no charge for the first 3 months at $100k+/mo commit.
- Consolidated pricing: yes — attached is an optional fixed-fee annual pricing line for 13-month retention ("13m audit bundle") that covers storage and retrieval SLA. We recommend fixed-fee if procurement prefers predictability.
- Audit logs & DSARs: audit logs are maintained in a tamper-evident store and support the audit trail you describe; we will add language in the SOW to ensure they're searchable for DSAR purposes.

As a reminder on commercial mechanics:
  * Committed spend tiers (example): $50k/mo -> 7% discount; $100k/mo -> 12% discount + premium controls included for first 6 months.
  * Ramp: 3 months to reach committed throughput; early usage credits apply to the commit.
  * Pricing lock: we can hold the compliance add-on pricing for 30 days from the date of the signed MAP.

Attachments: SOC2-Attestation.pdf (for your audit team) and the updated pricing appendix. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/abcdef123456

If this looks good I'd suggest a short call with legal on Thursday to close open redlines.

—Karthik
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: internal: final MAP proposal (post-call)

Recap after today's call with MedSys (Claire + legal):

- Agreed MAP milestones: Eval (2w), Pilot (4w), Ramp (8w) with acceptance criteria and two rollback triggers (latency SLA, error-rate threshold).
- Commercial summary:
  * Proposed deal_id: MSH-2026-042
  * Commit structure: 12-month term with a 3-month ramp; target commit $100k/mo yields 12% discount and inclusion of premium controls for months 1–6.
  * Compliance add-ons: 13-month audit-bundle offered as an optional fixed-fee annual line (preferred by procurement) OR a per-GB/month model; we recommend the fixed fee to minimize procurement friction.
- Timing: MedSys aims to sign the MAP by Feb 28 if we deliver the fixed-fee appendix and a DocuSign.

Next steps: Marissa to finalize the fixed-fee appendix and I will push the HubSpot record live and prepare the DocuSign envelope with the MAP + SOW.

Rishi
Head of Sales Operations (acting), Redwood Inference
